title: RAP performance
explain: Avoid chatty EML in loops; design for set-based operations. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "RAP performance" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without RAP performance, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of RAP performance without a failure story
howToApply: Use RAP performance explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “RAP performance” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (RAP → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using RAP performance without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “RAP performance” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “RAP performance”.
